verdict.rationale: Orama is a search engine, so per-user scoped or tenant search tokens are a fair axis. The pack never documents scoped, tenant, or secured API keys that enforce per-user document restrictions. Search filters, facets, and segregated data sources are adjacent features a developer might use to build tenant isolation; they are not token-enforced scoping. The Secure Proxy only hides the OpenAI API key and does nothing to restrict which documents a user can search.

support.subject: As a developer, scoped or tenant tokens restrict each end user's searches to their own documents without separate indexes per user
